caption: The drawing depicts a symmetrical, cross-shaped ornamental object that appears to be made of metal or wood, positioned centrally on a plain, cream or off-white background. The ornament consists of four leaf-like extensions radiating from a central circular knob or button, with each extension featuring curved and pointed edges and vein-like details. The primary color of the object is a dark brown with shades of black, and some lighter brown or rusty tones are visible, especially along the veins and edges, suggesting texture or wear. Each of the four extensions has a small, oval-shaped cut-out near the center, and the overall style of the object gives a sense of relief and depth due to the use of shadow and highlight. In the bottom center, there is a signature in small, neat handwriting that reads "Max Leenheks 1938."
title: Rosette
